## Store Sync

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/store-sync/overview/): Store Sync is for merchants who want to make their full product catalog and order management accessible to AI shopping assistants.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/store-sync/advanced): This guide is for developers who have completed the core Store Sync integration and want to extend their API to support specialized shopping experiences.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/store-sync/create-catalog): Your platform needs to provide essential product data to enable product discovery and merchant management in Store Sync.
